author_scope: Independent reviewer; no semantic-guidance.php or gateway-components.php question set read before freezing
source_policy: Original synthetic business questions from R5 product requirements; not customer data; all questions and expectations frozen before inspecting Projector, Planner or Registry implementation
grading_policy: Correct compilation is not factual/business completion. Ambiguity, capability refusal, permission refusal, understanding failure and wrong hit are separate. Never change questions to accommodate implementation. Once exposed, this set becomes regression evidence, not a fresh blind set.

cases.question: 午休前核对一下，今天现金业绩合计多少？
请列出9月1日到9月8日的消耗业绩总额。
昨天、今天的现金业绩分别是多少？不用算差额。
最近七天每天的现金业绩，按天给我看看。
按今天现金业绩从高到低，列出前五家门店。
今天消耗业绩倒数五家的名单和金额一起给我。
这月现金和消耗业绩都要，分成两项展示。
preserve: two metrics not forced into one

cases.question: 把本月现金业绩汇总给我，再附一份Excel。
先不查钱数，解释一下现金业绩的统计口径。
消耗业绩这个指标是什么意思？
本月现金业绩后五名门店，结果也要导出为表格。
今天现金业绩和消耗业绩各是多少，再把昨天的两项并排放上。
今天业绩怎么样？
cases.correct_limit: Ask a meaningful metric choice; do not default to cash.

cases.question: 本月哪家店做得最好？
preserve: singular best not assumed top five
cases.correct_limit: Clarify criterion/count or accurately restrict; do not silently choose cash top five.

cases.question: 今天服务业绩有多少？
cases.correct_limit: Unavailable labor meaning must not make consumption falsely unique.

cases.question: 这月卖了多少？
cases.correct_limit: Do not substitute collected cash for sales or infer amount versus count.

cases.question: 今天合作方分到了多少钱？
cases.correct_limit: Distinguish commission, partner receipts and personnel performance; do not answer whole-store cash.

cases.question: 今天收入是多少？
cases.correct_limit: Do not automatically map all income to cash.

cases.question: 列一下今天最差的五家店。
cases.correct_limit: Ask only unresolved criterion; do not drop given five or today.

cases.question: 这个月门店经营健康吗？
cases.correct_limit: Guide to measurable available criterion or state missing ability; never invent a health score.

cases.question: 明天现金业绩有多少？
cases.correct_limit: Future actuals unavailable; no forecast or silently changed date.

cases.question: 8月3日到8月9日现金业绩汇总是多少？
cases.correct_limit: Outside current coverage; do not crop period.

cases.question: 今天现金业绩排前十名的门店有哪些？
cases.correct_limit: Current basic ranking supports five only; do not return five as ten.

cases.question: 今天现金业绩，只看张敏作为销售人的部分。
cases.correct_limit: Personnel grain/role support and permission required; do not return store total.

cases.question: 这个月美容师岗位产生的消耗业绩是多少？
cases.correct_limit: No automatic whole-store consumption substitute or role-based permission grant.

cases.question: 今天现金业绩排除体验项目后还剩多少？
cases.correct_limit: Unsupported exclusion must stop; do not delete exclusion.

cases.question: 只统计生美分类，本月现金和消耗各多少？
cases.correct_limit: All metrics must support complete category combination; no partial filter.

cases.question: 把今天现金减掉消耗，告诉我利润。
cases.correct_limit: Reject invented metric/formula; no model arithmetic.

cases.question: 今天退款业绩合计有多少？
cases.correct_limit: Unready refund mapping cannot become cash, negative cash or zero.

cases.question: 今天实际业绩是多少？
cases.correct_limit: Product formula is fixed but unready canonical mapping cannot be bypassed by local subtraction.

cases.question: 今天完成服务的是多少人，不要金额。
cases.correct_limit: Service people unavailable; do not return consumption amount or service events.

cases.question: 本月一共成交几笔订单？
cases.correct_limit: Order count is not cash amount or customer count.

cases.question: 截至上个月最后一天，卡项还有多少未耗金额？
cases.correct_limit: Current entitlement value cannot replace historical snapshot.

cases.question: 哪些库存批次会在下个月到期，分别还剩几件？
cases.correct_limit: Unregistered inventory ability; no unrelated performance data.

cases.question: 美容师岗位还有哪些必修课没完成？
cases.correct_limit: Future training domain unregistered; no inference from business performance.

cases.question: 昨天现金业绩比前天增长了百分之多少？
cases.correct_limit: Two-period amount comparison does not authorize growth calculation.
